scope.colors: gray baseline, blue estimate, red error
scope.logging: full native provenance plus full 20kHz observer logs; no scientific decimation

old_log_comparison: Time/Data exact isequaln, same configuration; reference_absent also compare N0 100ms baseline
new_signal_comparison: split generated blocks vs N1 pure composition on identical archived current/voltage inputs; tolerance absolute 1e-10 + relative 1e-9, no time interpolation

voltage_reconstruction.input: applied Tcm, actual ObsCarrier and controller UDC; no requested voltage or true rotor state
voltage_reconstruction.weighted_interval: sum of exact RL weights on each native-grid held-voltage piece; first partial interval invalid
voltage_reconstruction.independent_oracle: direct analytic exponential weights across complete interval plus independent gate/Clarke reconstruction
voltage_reconstruction.sequence_original_mode: -1 sentinel; original mode has direct thresholds and no active CCR queue
voltage_reconstruction.sequence_real_mode: ObsPWMTiming column7 exact active command sequence
voltage_reconstruction.truth_voltage_diagnostic: existing obs_phase_ideal at native grid; no actual terminal voltage used as formal observer input
voltage_reconstruction.minor_solver_stages: native-grid ZOH reconstruction; does not claim exact voltage integration at continuous ode4 intermediate stages

failure_policy: 失败包保留；不改变v1阈值；必选项未通过不进入N3
